notes: The start week is set by the dates poll. Plan to arrive 2–3 days early to acclimatise.

bookings.title: Shuttle Johannesburg → Witsieshoek Mountain Lodge
bookings.details: About 4–5 hours by road. Operators on the Links page.

bookings.title: Witsieshoek Mountain Lodge, night before Day 1
bookings.details: Closest beds to Sentinel Car Park

bookings.title: Lodge shuttle to Sentinel Car Park
bookings.details: Run by the lodge (R160 per person each way, 2026–27 rate). Buy the Witsieshoek day permit here.

bookings.title: Ezemvelo KZN Wildlife hiking permits
bookings.details: Bought in person at an Ezemvelo office (e.g. Royal Natal) before the start; also covers rescue. Sign the mountain register.

bookings.title: Night after the finish, near Bushman's Nek
bookings.details: Bushman's Nek resort or Underberg area. Carry passports: there is a border post at Bushman's Nek.

bookings.title: Shuttle Bushman's Nek → Johannesburg
bookings.details: About 6–7 hours. Underberg operators on the Links page.

links.title: Witsieshoek Mountain Lodge: getting here and the Sentinel shuttle
links.note: Lodge to Sentinel Car Park shuttle, R160 per person each way (2026–27 rate).

links.title: Champagne Shuttle and Coach Hire
links.note: Winterton-based; airport transfers and tailor-made group transport.

links.title: Underberg Express
links.note: Underberg shuttles and group transfers: the side Bushman's Nek is on.

links.title: Southern Berg Shuttle
links.note: Underberg, Durban and King Shaka airport.

links.title: Soul Adventures: DGT with Joburg pick-up
links.note: Package that drives from Joburg to Sentinel and collects at Bushman's Nek. Worth asking about transport only.

links.title: Witsieshoek Mountain Lodge
links.note: The usual night before the start.

links.title: Bushman's Nek resort
links.note: Hotel and self-catering right at the finish.

links.title: Sani Mountain Lodge (Sani Top)
links.note: On the route at Sani Top: the main bail-out and the only resupply.

links.title: Witsieshoek: hiking from the Sentinel side
links.note: Conservation and hiking fees for the Sentinel trail and chain ladders.

links.title: DGT permits and maps (Hiking South Africa forum)
links.note: Ezemvelo permit bought at an office beforehand; Slingsby maps recommended.

links.title: GT planning and logistics (Landlubbers)
links.note: Roads, fees by jurisdiction, passports and the Bushman's Nek border post.
